metadata.description: Task-specific skills that hand work to Apple's on-device Vision framework and Foundation Model. Biggest win: long PDFs, where Claude reads extracted text instead of page images.

plugins.name: ocr
plugins.description: Exact text from images and scanned pages via Apple Vision OCR, on-device. For images that must stay on your Mac, or many images at once.

plugins.name: pdf-to-text
plugins.description: PDF text extraction on-device: the embedded text layer where present, Apple Vision OCR where not.

plugins.name: describe-image
plugins.description: Experimental: describe an image or PDF page with Apple's on-device Foundation Model, keeping it on your Mac.

plugins.name: ask-image
plugins.description: Experimental: answer a simple question about an image or PDF page with Apple's on-device Foundation Model, keeping it on your Mac.
